reviews.comment: Perfect upgrade. Not a single install hitch. Note. Just go with the liquid cooler option and forget the drama. There's not much room for anything else if you try and install a bulky heatsink/fan.
reviews.author: inthefrey

reviews.title: Solid, reliable foundation for a professional workstation
reviews.comment: I used this ASUS TUF B760-PLUS WIFI for a client's work PC build, and it has been excellent. When building for a customer, I prioritize stability and reliability, and the TUF line always delivers. The installation was straightforward, and the built-in WiFi 6E is a great feature for an office environment where running ethernet cables isn't always an option. It has plenty of M.2 slots for high-speed storage and the VRM cooling is more than enough for a modern Intel i7. It’s a clean-looking board that doesn’t look too "gamer" for an office, and it performed perfectly right out of the box. Highly recommended for anyone building a high-performance work machine.
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: Appealing, Reliable, Compatible, and Affordable
reviews.comment: I got this mother board on sale for around $160.  I’ve always been a big ASUS fan, and have never had any problems with any of their products. This motherboard was no different with a built in WIFI adapter, DDR5 capabilities, compatible with Intels newer generation processors (LGA 1700), M.2 storage capabilities and more. You really can’t beat it for the price. I installed this mother board paired with the Intel i5 13600kf CPU into my PC to replace my older ASUS motherboard, and it only took me about 45min to swap everything taking my time and cleaning my case as I went. I installed windows, and everything booted right up with no problems. Motherboard recognized all my fans, RAM, and CPU with no problems. The instruction manual is also very thorough, and ASUS’ webpage is always very helpful if you have further questions. Great company and great product overall for the price.
reviews.author: Carlos Paredes III
